name: print-social-gradient-glow-portfolio-site-promo
title: Portfolio Site and Mobile View on Neon Gradient
whatItIs: A promo graphic showing a photographer's portfolio website on desktop with a phone view overlapping its edge, a black app-icon tile at the left, on a black background with blue and magenta glows.
whatItMeans: Showing the same site at two sizes proves responsiveness without saying it, and the vivid photography brings color to a mostly monochrome frame. The icon tile anchors the brand.
techniques: Cropped browser window running off the bottom edge to imply more content
Overlapping a phone frame over the desktop frame to show responsive behavior
Photography as the color payload against neutral UI and a dark surround
Placing a bold brand tile at the left edge to sign the composition
Blue and magenta glows in opposite corners to balance the frame
bestFor: Announcing a portfolio or website-builder feature
Showcasing customer work in social carousels

vocabulary.definition: Showing desktop and mobile versions together in one composition.
Letting a screenshot run off the edge of the canvas to imply continuation.
A square rounded app-icon shape used as a compact logo stamp.
